name: Andaz Maui at Wailea
positioning: Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort: a 15-acre oceanfront resort in Wailea with direct access to Mokapu Beach, cascading infinity pools and a Hawaiian beach house aesthetic
best_for: Travelers who want a design-forward beach resort with direct beach access
Families and groups wanting villas with full kitchens and private hot tubs or plunge pools

facts.text: Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort is a 15-acre retreat in Wailea, Maui, with direct access to Mokapu Beach.
The resort is design-forward and inspired by the Hawaiian beach house aesthetic.
Formerly the Renaissance Wailea Beach Resort, the property was transformed by the Rockwell Group when it became the Andaz Maui in 2013.
Every room, suite and villa has a private lanai.
Rooms use neutral color palettes and wood furnishings so the tropical setting and Pacific Ocean views take center stage.
Guest rooms have a complimentary minibar with local snacks and nonalcoholic beverages, replenished daily.
The Two Bedroom Ocean Front Villa has a loft room designed for kids, with two loft beds.
'Awili Spa & Salon offers restorative massages, beauty services and treatments inspired by island botanicals.
The Art of Poke is a hands-on experience where guests craft their own poke with the culinary team using fresh local ingredients.
Along Mokapu Beach, the resort offers ocean activities like snorkeling and Hawaiian canoe experiences.
Ka'ana Kitchen, the signature restaurant, is built around an open kitchen and sources from local farmers, artisans and fishermen.
Morimoto Maui, from chef Masaharu Morimoto, serves lunch and dinner in a beachfront setting.

highlights.text: Multi-tiered infinity pools cascade toward the ocean.
Villas include full kitchens, large indoor-outdoor living spaces, private hot tubs, and extras like bunk bed rooms and game areas.
The Feast at Mokapu luau is a beachfront feast on the resort's lawn by Mokapu Beach, telling the story of Hawaii's Polynesian ancestors arriving on Maui.
Ground-floor Ilikai villas have a spacious lawn with a private plunge pool and a Viking outdoor grill.

considerations.text: The hotel offers connecting rooms, family-friendly amenities and babysitting referrals, though it leans more adult-oriented overall.
Kahului Airport is 16 miles from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury Wailea location.
